run_audio_simulation: run a habitat-sim simulator with an audio sensor to capture binaural audio observations in a 3D scene
create_acoustics_config: create an RLRAudioPropagationConfiguration with materials enabled for realistic audio propagation simulation
configure_channel_layout: configure a binaural channel layout with two channels for stereo audio sensor output
add_audio_sensor: add an AudioSensorSpec to the simulator with acoustics config and channel layout settings
get_sensor_observations: get audio sensor observations from the simulator and print or write impulse response data
